name: SubLingo
description: Translate nearby external SRT/ASS cues into an IINA second subtitle track.

permissionDescriptions.network-request: Connect to the bundled loopback helper, which contacts only the translation service you select.
permissionDescriptions.file-system: Read the selected external subtitle and maintain an encrypted credential vault and temporary translated track.
permissionDescriptions.subtitle: Read the selected external subtitle and manage only SubLingo's translated secondary track.
permissionDescriptions.preferences: Save non-secret profile metadata, language choices, and sidebar settings.
